title: A letter from Hogwarts
text: One night, a strange old man named Albus Dumbledore, a stern witch called Professor McGonagall and an enormous man named Hagrid left a baby on a doorstep in Privet Drive. The baby was Harry Potter. His parents had been killed by a dark wizard, Voldemort, but Voldemort’s attack on Harry failed, leaving only a lightning-shaped scar, and the dark wizard vanished. Across the country, witches and wizards toasted “the boy who lived.”

Ten years later, Harry knows none of this. He lives with his aunt Petunia, uncle Vernon and spoiled cousin Dudley, who make him sleep in a cupboard under the stairs. Odd things keep happening around him: at the zoo he talks to a snake, and the glass of its tank simply disappears.

Then letters start arriving for Harry, addressed to his cupboard. Uncle Vernon destroys them, but more and more pour in, until he drags the family to a shack on a rock at sea. At midnight on Harry’s eleventh birthday, the door crashes open.

As chapter 4 closes, Hagrid has told Harry the truth: he is a wizard, he has a place at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, and his parents did not die in a car crash, as he was told, but were murdered by Voldemort. Harry is famous in a world he never knew existed, and he is going to Hogwarts.

title: First weeks at Hogwarts
text: Harry Potter, raised by his unkind aunt and uncle, the Dursleys, learned on his eleventh birthday that he is a wizard. His parents were murdered by the dark wizard Voldemort, whose curse failed on baby Harry and left him with a lightning-shaped scar and a fame he knew nothing about.

The giant Hagrid took Harry shopping in Diagon Alley, where he found he has a fortune at the wizard bank Gringotts and bought a wand with a curious link to his scar. Hagrid also collected a small, mysterious package from a vault there. On the Hogwarts Express, Harry made friends with Ron Weasley, met bossy Hermione Granger and forgetful Neville Longbottom, and turned down the friendship of the snobbish Draco Malfoy.

The Sorting Hat put Harry in Gryffindor with Ron, Hermione and Neville, after Harry begged not to be sent to Slytherin. Classes are hard, and the Potions master, Professor Snape, seems to hate him; Harry’s scar burned when Snape first looked at him. Harry also learned that the Gringotts vault Hagrid emptied was broken into that same day.

Harry turns out to be a natural on a broomstick and becomes the youngest Seeker in a century. As chapter 9 closes, Malfoy has tricked him into a midnight duel, and while fleeing the caretaker, Harry, Ron, Hermione and Neville have stumbled into the forbidden third-floor corridor, where a huge three-headed dog stands guard over a trapdoor.

title: The secret of the trapdoor
text: Harry Potter, the orphan who survived the dark wizard Voldemort’s curse as a baby, is in his first year at Hogwarts, sorted into Gryffindor with his best friend Ron Weasley. He is the new Seeker on the house Quidditch team, and the Potions master, Professor Snape, plainly loathes him. Early in term, Harry, Ron, Hermione and Neville stumbled on a three-headed dog guarding a trapdoor in a forbidden corridor, around the time a vault at Gringotts, emptied by Hagrid, was broken into.

On Halloween a troll got into the castle, and when Harry and Ron rescued Hermione from it, the three became firm friends. Harry spotted a wound on Snape’s leg and suspects he tried to get past the dog, which Hagrid calls Fluffy. When Harry’s broom went wild in his first match, Hermione was sure Snape was jinxing it and set his robes on fire. Hagrid let slip a name: Nicolas Flamel.

At Christmas, Harry received his father’s Invisibility Cloak and discovered the Mirror of Erised, which showed him his parents. Dumbledore explained that it shows only your deepest desire, and warned him not to dwell on dreams.

At last a Chocolate Frog card reveals that Flamel made the Sorcerer’s Stone, which brings gold and eternal life, and the friends realise that Fluffy must be guarding it. As chapter 13 closes, Gryffindor has won another match, and Harry has overheard Snape threatening the nervous Professor Quirrell in the forest. The three are convinced Snape is after the Stone.
